articles.summary: TipRanks: United Airlines price target raised to $153 from $132 at Citi. Citi analyst John Godyn raised the firm’s price target on United Airlines (UAL) to $153 from $132 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. The firm updated targets in the airlines group as part of a Q4 earnings preview. Citi’s business travel barometer has bottomed, the analyst tells investors in a research note.
